title: Output schema of AI Memory Actor
description: Result of the requested memory action (remember, recall, search, forget, context_pack, update, stats, prune).

result.title: Action result
result.description: One item in the default dataset containing the action result with fields such as action, ok, memories, results, stats, memoryStoreId, and storeName.

output.title: OUTPUT record
output.description: The OUTPUT record stored in the default key-value store with the full action result.
